1._section_summary: This section describes two measurement instruments used in the research: the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), a 30-item scale measuring media influences on body image across four factors (Information, Pressure, Internalisation-General, and Internalisation-Athlete), and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item unidimensional scale measuring positive body image with good psychometric properties (Cronbach's alpha = .90). No study-specific data, participant demographics, or correlation results are presented in this section.
